title: Material: valid status comments hide pending release walks
detail: F1. A user maintaining valid YAML task frontmatter can write status: done # completed. Spacedock and the real producer read done and report two pending releases; the new prefilter emits no line. value-ac[AC-13]: the scan never hides a due release; also AC-11. Trigger: yaml-status.json and acceptance.log.
fix: Route through implementation feedback; make the scan preserve Spacedock's YAML field semantics and retain this real-producer regression.

title: Material: valid claim comments repeat an already claimed walk
detail: F2. An acceptance task with release-acceptance: book-pickup/r1 # already filed is read by Spacedock as book-pickup/r1, but due prints its reminder again. value-ac[AC-11]: a live or archived claiming task must silence its release. Trigger: yaml-claim.json and acceptance.log.
fix: Use the same field semantics for claims; do not treat the YAML comment as part of the claim.

title: Needs decision: literal main comparison conflicts with stacked validation
detail: F3. AC-16 names origin/main, currently e1bee223c47a. That diff includes the prerequisite's EXTENSION.md and ADR 0053, and number_guards exits 1 for unreserved 0053. The explicitly authorized #772 stack at 606781cbe has no extension change and its number check passes. The validator cannot silently replace the literal criterion.
fix: FO must disposition the prerequisite/base boundary; rerun on the final integrated candidate or obtain the required scope ruling.

title: Needs decision: an earlier dispatch record fails the required checker
detail: F4. dispatch_records.py exits 1: needs a scope-notes line naming main as the completion recipient. The record says final-reply completion but omits the recognized Done line; later implementation records have it. No product symptom is established.
fix: FO owns the dispatch-record correction/disposition; preserve the Paseo final-reply completion route.
